formal_role: Defines local convergence through quantified tolerances
systems_modeling_role: Clarifies what it means for model outputs to approach a target under input refinement
review_warning: Requires an admissible domain and a specified output metric

formal_role: Tests limits through all admissible sequences approaching the target
systems_modeling_role: Useful for identifying path-dependent or sequence-dependent model behavior
review_warning: A single sequence is not enough to prove a limit but two conflicting sequences can disprove one

formal_role: Controls convergence across an entire domain using a supremum norm
systems_modeling_role: Supports stronger claims about global approximation behavior
review_warning: Pointwise convergence alone may not preserve continuity or stability

formal_role: Concerns when limits commute with integration differentiation expectation or optimization
systems_modeling_role: Important for simulation aggregation uncertainty and sensitivity analysis
review_warning: Requires additional hypotheses such as domination uniform convergence compactness or stability
